title: Clean Architecture Layers
description: A clean architecture layers diagram showing the four concentric layers: Entities (domain), Use Cases (application), Interface Adapters (controllers, presenters, repositories), and Frameworks & Drivers (web server, database, cloud SDK). This template models Uncle Bob's Clean Architecture with the dependency rule where inner layers never depend on outer layers, ensuring the domain model remains pure and framework-independent. Essential reference for software architects enforcing architectural boundaries.
